pairs: When the Lord turned back the captivity of Zion,
we became like those who are consoled.
Tunc repletum est gaudio os nostrum,
Then our mouth was filled with gladness
Then they will say among the nations:
“The Lord has done great things for them.”
The Lord has done great things for us.
captivitatem nostram, sicut torrens in austro.
O Lord, like a torrent in the south.
Qui seminant in lacrimis, in exsultatione metent.
Those who sow in tears shall reap in exultation.
But when returning, they will arrive with exultation, carrying their sheaves.
